  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT)::DATE AS month,
    SUM(ORDER_TOTAL) AS revenue
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT)
)
SELECT 
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_revenue,
  CASE 
    WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2)
  END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

WITH customer_first_order AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    MIN(ORDERED_AT) as first_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', cfo.first_order_date) as acquisition_month,
    cfo.CUSTOMER_ID,
    o.ORDER_TOTAL
  FROM customer_first_order cfo
  JOIN ORDERS o ON cfo.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT
  acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) as customer_count,
  SUM(ORDER_TOTAL) as total_lifetime_revenue
FROM cohorts
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY acquisition_month

WITH first_order_dates AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(ORDERED_AT)) AS acquisition_month
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
customer_cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    fod.CUSTOMER_ID,
    fod.acquisition_month
  FROM first_order_dates fod
),
lifetime_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    cc.acquisition_month,
    cc.CUSTOMER_ID,
    SUM(o.ORDER_TOTAL) AS customer_lifetime_revenue
  FROM customer_cohorts cc
  JOIN ORDERS o ON cc.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
  GROUP BY cc.acquisition_month, cc.CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT
  acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS customer_count,
  SUM(customer_lifetime_revenue) AS total_lifetime_revenue
FROM lifetime_revenue
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY acquisition_month;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(ORDERED_AT)) AS ACQUISITION_MONTH,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT,
  SUM(ORDER_TOTAL) AS TOTAL_LIFETIME_REVENUE

JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY P.BRAND
ORDER BY REVENUE DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    U.ID,
    U.FIRST_NAME,
    U.LAST_NAME,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SPEND
FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
JOIN USERS U ON OI.USER_ID = U.ID
GROUP BY U.ID, U.FIRST_NAME, U.LAST_NAME
ORDER BY TOTAL_SPEND DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)::DATE AS MONTH,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS REVENUE
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  WHERE OI.CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)
),
revenue_with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    MONTH,
    REVENUE,
    LAG(REVENUE) OVER (ORDER BY MONTH) AS PREV_MONTH_REVENUE
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  MONTH,
  REVENUE,
  PREV_MONTH_REVENUE,
  ROUND(((REVENUE - PREV_MONTH_REVENUE) / PREV_MONTH_REVENUE * 100), 2) AS MOM_GROWTH_RATE_PCT
FROM revenue_with_lag
ORDER BY MONTH;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)::DATE AS month,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS revenue
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  WHERE OI.CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)
),
revenue_with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_month_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN prev_month_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((revenue - prev_month_revenue) / prev_month_revenue * 100, 2)
  END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM revenue_with_lag
ORDER BY month

WITH customers_by_state_source AS (
  SELECT 
    U.STATE,
    U.TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT U.ID) AS customer_count
  FROM USERS U
  INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON U.ID = O.USER_ID
  WHERE U.STATE IS NOT NULL
    AND U.COUNTRY = 'USA'
  GROUP BY U.STATE, U.TRAFFIC_SOURCE
),
ranked_sources AS (
  SELECT 
    STATE,
    TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
    customer_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY STATE ORDER BY customer_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM customers_by_state_source
)
SELECT 
  STATE,
  TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
  customer_count
FROM ranked_sources
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY STATE;

WITH ordered_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    U.STATE,
    U.TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
    U.ID
  FROM USERS U
  INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON U.ID = O.USER_ID
  WHERE U.COUNTRY = 'USA' OR U.STATE IS NOT NULL
)
,
traffic_source_counts AS (
  SELECT
    STATE,
    TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
    COUNT(ID) AS customer_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY STATE ORDER BY COUNT(ID) DESC) AS rn
  FROM ordered_users
  GROUP BY STATE, TRAFFIC_SOURCE
)
SELECT
  STATE,
  TRAFFIC_SOURCE,
  customer_count
FROM traffic_source_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY STATE

WITH monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month,
    SUM(OP.PAYMENT_VALUE) AS business_volume
  FROM ORDERS O
  JOIN ORDER_PAYMENTS OP ON O.ORDER_ID = OP.ORDER_ID
  WHERE O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', O.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)
),
monthly_volume_with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    business_volume,
    LAG(business_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_volume
  FROM monthly_volume
  ORDER BY month
)
SELECT 
  month,
  business_volume,
  CASE 
    WHEN prev_month_volume IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((business_volume - prev_month_volume) / prev_month_volume) * 100, 2)
  END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_volume_with_lag
ORDER BY month;

WITH monthly_volume AS (

SELECT

  LAG(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_volume,
  ROUND(
    ((total_volume - LAG(total_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month)) /

  ) AS mom_growth_rate_percent
FROM monthly_volume

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT >= 2 THEN CUSTOMER_ID END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID), 
    2
  ) AS REPEAT_CUSTOMER_RATE_PERCENT
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT
  FROM ORDERS
  WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
) AS CUSTOMER_ORDERS

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered_order_count >= 2 THEN CUSTOMER_ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS delivered_order_count
  FROM ORDERS
  WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
)

  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delivered_order_count >= 2 THEN CUSTOMER_ID END) / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID),
    2
  ) AS repeat_customer_rate_percent
FROM (
  SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS delivered_order_count
  FROM ORDERS
  WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
)

  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) as order_count
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as repeat_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
  WHERE order_count >= 2
),
total_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
)

  ROUND(100.0 * rc.repeat_count / tc.total_count, 2) as repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM repeat_customers rc, total_customers tc

        AND o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
      THEN oi.PRICE

    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
        AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
        AND o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
      THEN oi.PRICE 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS prior_90_spending
  FROM MARKETPLACE.CUSTOMERS c
  JOIN MARKETPLACE.ORDERS o ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
  JOIN MARKETPLACE.ORDER_ITEMS oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)

  SELECT STORE_ID,
         SUM(SUBTOTAL) FILTER (

WITH product_rev AS (
  SELECT p.CATEGORY, p.ID, p.NAME, SUM(oi.SALE_PRICE) AS revenue
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN PRODUCTS p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.ID

)

         SUM(SALE_PRICE) FILTER (
           WHERE CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 90 DAY
             AND STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')) AS last90_spend,
         SUM(SALE_PRICE) FILTER (
           WHERE CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 180 DAY

  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)

FROM per_customer
WHERE last90_spend > COALESCE(prior90_spend, 0)

        100.0 * COUNT_IF(order_count >= 2) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM ORDERS
    GROUP BY USER_ID
) user_orders

    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        COUNT(ORDER_ID) AS num_orders
    FROM ORDERS
    GROUP BY USER_ID
)

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN num_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM order_counts

SELECT

  P.ID,
  P.NAME,
  SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY P.CATEGORY, P.ID, P.NAME
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.CATEGORY ORDER BY SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) DESC) = 1
ORDER BY TOTAL_REVENUE DESC

  CATEGORY,
  NAME,
  TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM (
  SELECT
    P.CATEGORY,
    P.NAME,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.CATEGORY ORDER BY SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) DESC) AS RN
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
  WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  GROUP BY P.CATEGORY, P.NAME
)
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY CATEGORY;

WITH recent_90 AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    SUM(SALE_PRICE) as revenue_last_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= CAST('2026-04-25' AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT < CAST('2026-04-25' AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY USER_ID
),
prior_90 AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    SUM(SALE_PRICE) as revenue_prior_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= CAST('2026-04-25' AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT < CAST('2026-04-25' AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.USER_ID) as customer_count
FROM recent_90 r
INNER JOIN prior_90 p ON r.USER_ID = p.USER_ID
WHERE r.revenue_last_90 > p.revenue_prior_90

)

WITH periods AS (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CREATED_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-25' AND CREATED_AT < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-25' THEN SALE_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS last_90,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CREATED_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-27' AND CREATED_AT < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-25' THEN SALE_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS prev_90
    FROM ORDER_ITEMS
    WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

    GROUP BY USER_ID
)

WITH date_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-04-25' AS today,
        DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL '90' DAY AS last_90_start,
        DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL '180' DAY AS prev_90_start
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        OI.USER_ID,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN OI.CREATED_AT >= (SELECT last_90_start FROM date_ranges)
             AND OI.CREATED_AT < (SELECT today FROM date_ranges)
             AND OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
            THEN OI.SALE_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS last_90_spend,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN OI.CREATED_AT >= (SELECT prev_90_start FROM date_ranges)
             AND OI.CREATED_AT < (SELECT last_90_start FROM date_ranges)
             AND OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
            THEN OI.SALE_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS prev_90_spend
    FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
    WHERE OI.CREATED_AT >= (SELECT prev_90_start FROM date_ranges)
      AND OI.CREATED_AT < (SELECT today FROM date_ranges)
    GROUP BY OI.USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM customer_spending
WHERE last_90_spend > prev_90_spend

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    CREATED_AT,
    LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
),
days_between_orders AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    (EXTRACT(DAY FROM CREATED_AT - prev_order_date)) AS days_between
  FROM customer_orders
  WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
customer_avg_days AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    AVG(days_between) AS avg_days_per_customer
  FROM days_between_orders
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_days_per_customer) AS avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM customer_avg_days

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    CREATED_AT,
    LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
  WHERE USER_ID IS NOT NULL
),
order_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    (CREATED_AT - prev_order_date) AS gap_interval
  FROM customer_orders
  WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
customer_avg_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    USER_ID,
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM gap_interval)) AS avg_days_between_orders
  FROM order_gaps
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_days_between_orders) AS overall_avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM customer_avg_gaps

WITH ORDER_GAPS AS (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        CREATED_AT,
        LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS PREV_ORDER_AT
    FROM ORDERS
),
GAPS_IN_DAYS AS (
    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        DATE_DIFF('day', PREV_ORDER_AT, CREATED_AT) AS DAYS_BETWEEN
    FROM ORDER_GAPS
    WHERE PREV_ORDER_AT IS NOT NULL
),

    SELECT
        USER_ID,
        AVG(DAYS_BETWEEN) AS AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_ORDERS

    GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_ORDERS), 2) AS AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_CONSECUTIVE_ORDERS
FROM AVG_PER_CUSTOMER
